nodes.name: _bad.yaml
nodes.summary: Deliberately malformed scenario-override fixture containing an unknown_key, used to exercise the input-validation path that should reject configs with unrecognized fields.

nodes.name: debt_smoke.yaml
nodes.summary: Full scenario-override config for a debt-sizing smoke test, supplying a complete 150 MW project profile (capacity, tariff, CAPEX/OPEX, gearing, tenor, interest rate, DSCR targets, DSRA) to drive the debt module end-to-end.

nodes.name: demo_override.yaml
nodes.summary: Minimal demonstration override that sets the power-purchase tariff to 0.12 USD/kWh, used to show how a single base-case parameter can be overridden at runtime.

nodes.name: demo_override_low.yaml
nodes.summary: Minimal low-tariff demonstration override setting the power-purchase tariff to 0.08 USD/kWh, paired with demo_override.yaml to illustrate a stressed downside pricing scenario.
